name: project-hours
description: Claude Code time per project and per week, with an alert when a priority project goes quiet

language.title: Language
language.description: Display language (also settable for every mod at once with /langmod)

idleMinutes.title: Idle threshold (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: A gap between two events longer than this ends the active segment

aliases.title: Project aliases
aliases.description: Display names, separated by ';': a path prefix or a repo name, '=', the name. Example: ~/code/sip/edge=sip/edge; k4u-erp=ERP

priorityProjects.title: Priority projects
priorityProjects.description: Projects to watch, separated by ';': name=max weeks without activity. Example: sip/edge=3

toolingProjects.title: Tooling projects
toolingProjects.description: Projects flagged as tooling (time on tools rather than on the substance), separated by ';'

openOnStart.title: Open the panel on start
openOnStart.description: Open the Hours panel in every session (otherwise: /hours panel)
